title: Kleinmond inniebos Kunstefees (KliK) 2026
summary: Three days, multiple venues, one small seaside town: KliK 2026 takes over Kleinmond from 27 to 29 November 2026 with poetry, music, theatre, storytelling and art.
description: KliK 2026 brings together acclaimed writers, poets, storytellers, musicians, publishers, and artists for a vibrant celebration of language, culture and creativity. Across multiple venues, enjoy author talks, storytelling sessions, a writing workshop, poetry and music performances, a Writers’ Café, Sip & Paint, and a guided Strandlooper Kruie Kuier experience. Alongside the ticketed programme, a full weekend of free activity runs for the community. There’s the KliK Market, a children and youth programme at Mthimkhulu, the See en Fynbos Paradys walk along Kleinmond’s coastline, and an Open Mic. Choose a 3-day or 2-day pass for the full run, a single day pass, or tickets to individual sessions.
profile: KliK, the Kleinmond inniebos Kunstefees, is a three-day festival of words, music and art across venues in Kleinmond from 27 to 29 November 2026. Visitors attend author talks, storytelling, poetry and music performances, a writing workshop and a Sip & Paint, alongside a free market, coastal walk and open mic. Passes cost R100 to R300, so it suits readers, writers and anyone wanting an inspiring weekend by the sea.
